problem_statement: When the HTTP client receives a 5xx (server error) response, the response body is dropped instead of being delivered to the caller. A caller that issues a request against a server returning a 5xx status with a body (for example an error message in the body) does not receive that body, and the underlying HTTP parser also errors out when it encounters the body. The body of a 5xx response must be delivered to the caller like any other response body, and the 5xx status code must still be reported to the caller.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/lib/http_client -s tests/net/lib/http_client/net.http_client -s net.http_client -O twister-out --no-clean -W
